openIssues.title: Elevated false-positive rate on ASUS ROG boards running Armoury Crate
openIssues.description: Armoury Crate's AsIO3.sys driver registers a kernel callback pattern that occasionally trips our instrumentation-callback heuristic. Not a security issue — purely a detection tuning problem.
openIssues.workaround: Partners can temporarily exclude AsIO3.sys via the kernel-scan allowlist in the partner dashboard (Settings → Detection Tuning → Driver Allowlist).

openIssues.title: Webhook retry backoff too aggressive under regional failover
openIssues.affectedRate: Delivery delay up to 90s during failover windows only
openIssues.description: When a region fails health checks and traffic reroutes, queued webhook retries back off further than necessary before the new region is confirmed healthy, adding avoidable delivery latency.
openIssues.workaround: None needed for most integrations — events still deliver, just later than normal during failover. Partners polling the Ban API directly are unaffected.

openIssues.title: SDK Unity package occasionally double-fires OnSessionStart in Editor
openIssues.affectedRate: Editor/Play-mode only — not observed in packaged builds
openIssues.description: Domain reload in the Unity Editor can occasionally re-fire the session-start callback before the prior session has fully torn down, producing duplicate telemetry rows in Editor testing.
openIssues.workaround: Ignore duplicate rows in Editor test data, or wrap OnSessionStart with a one-shot guard. Packaged builds are unaffected.
